document.title: Terrorism: Bin Ladin Determined to Strike in the US
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: Senior Executive Intelligence Brief. Source: 9/11 Commission Report, Chapter 8, Endnote 38; Chapter 11, Endnote 5; p. 342.

persons.name: Usama Bin Ladin
persons.role: al-Qa'ida leader planning terrorist attacks against the US

mentions.quote: Usama Bin Ladin since 1997 has wanted to conduct terrorist attacks in the US.
Bin Ladin implied in US television interviews in 1997 and 1998 that his followers would follow the example of World Trade Center bomber Ramzi Yousef

persons.name: Ramzi Yousef
persons.role: World Trade Center bomber, cited as an example by Bin Ladin

mentions.quote: his followers would follow the example of World Trade Center bomber Ramzi Yousef and "bring the fighting to America."

persons.name: Ahmed Ressam
persons.role: Convicted millennium plotter who planned to attack Los Angeles International Airport

mentions.quote: Convicted plotter Ahmed Ressam says that he conceived the idea to attack Los Angeles International Airport himself

persons.name: Abu Zubaydah
persons.role: Bin Ladin lieutenant who encouraged and facilitated Ressam's operation and planned own US attack in 1998

mentions.quote: Bin Ladin lieutenant Abu Zubaydah encouraged him and helped facilitate the operation.
in 1998 Abu Zubaydah was planning his own US attack.

events.description: Bin Ladin associates surveilled US Embassies in Nairobi and Dar es Salaam.
Some members of the Nairobi cell planning the bombings were arrested and deported.
Bin Ladin implied in US TV interviews (1997 and 1998) that followers would bring fighting to America.
Bombings of US Embassies in Kenya and Tanzania.
Millennium plotting in Canada, including plan to attack Los Angeles International Airport.
CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief issued.
Bin Ladin implied in US television interviews that followers would follow Ramzi Yousef's example (interviews in 1997 and 1998).
Bin Ladin implied in a second US television interview that followers would bring the fighting to America.
Bin Ladin associates surveilled the US Embassies in Nairobi and Dar es Salaam.
Attacks on the US Embassies in Kenya and Tanzania.
A Bin Ladin cell in New York was recruiting Muslim-American youth for attacks.
Millennium plot in Canada to attack Los Angeles International Airport; Ressam convicted.
Abu Zubaydah was planning his own US attack.
A senior Egyptian Islamic Jihad member lived in California.
CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief 'Bin Ladin Determined To Strike in the US' issued.

key_claims: Bin Ladin has wanted to attack inside the US since 1997.
The 1999 millennium plot in Canada may have been his first serious US attempt, with Abu Zubaydah's facilitation.
The 1998 East Africa embassy bombings show he plans operations years in advance and is not deterred by setbacks.
Al-Qa'ida members, including US citizens, have resided in or traveled to the US and apparently maintain a support structure there.
A Bin Ladin cell in New York in 1998 was recruiting Muslim-American youth.
